image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a pipe organ installed against a textured stone wall. The image features a dense array of vertical silver metallic pipes of varying diameters and heights, arranged in a stepped formation. To the left, a distinct cluster of larger pipes is housed in a decorative red and gold casing with ornate detailing. Below the main pipe array, a wooden structure (likely part of the console or casing) is visible, but the keyboards and pedalboard are not clearly shown in this cropped view.

The red and gold decorative element on the left has ambiguous geometry. The connection points between the red frame and the gold accents are slightly fuzzy and lack clear mechanical logic. The perspective of the circular cutouts seems slightly inconsistent with the rest of the structure.

Some of the thinner pipes in the middle ground appear to waver slightly or merge subtly with adjacent pipes, rather than maintaining perfect cylindrical separation. This is a minor deviation but noticeable upon close inspection.
